Place a passed-out or unresponsive person who is breathing into the **recovery position** on their side to keep their airway open and prevent choking on vomit. **Call 911 immediately** if they cannot be woken, have slow or irregular breathing, cold/pale/bluish skin, seizures, or vomit while unconscious.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17xYQlYYQaH8Au0qQRBtFYQwvfw4p4DYvzftit0Ub_XYcw7A2vd7ejQMVydIcRFyacp9_PLWtMBsGjs875uD8VInLKL__aIbPtbH787_wOD0KoUwr49_fxW8wqZvDMRqmVfj6YN3i_ea2CCwa1WdV4-raX3jIVJzZVsS8oyVD2uA56v9Bv_0KFQg2DU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXfuCmhsfD0k-Tircc6Ipi7Ke6zaLMt1n28L3JyeYne4J0iKOulKsPuHhxiM9AYwMSTcDipUQuIk4T1_dhGC6Sm7wIfhj8Nfm1h0VsiyBVOKMux22IWONreZr-dSgQafDFYhUKngxnbL54Dq7lU6oP518)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n4fQQTKIC00&t=37)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1-Vey8GX2Lm3b8Ts6193oTrlrDsEvhRvebwrpu5qOIXQf-rnbl1QsJP6l01MD4-pZRHKHQYW4r_V8_XwKT-WfKvt_sk_CIEsBQWQ9aEX-cOWtJROZeXd8Mx2ht1Z9XjJXOfaLZp4sAYxB9t1RxMpzEOqJv7kXTgW5_UYT_uJYY6y01sc1Ue6VzAzIVC1Q2dz_T0zOb-o2DI3sun0)

### How to Place Someone in the Recovery Position

1. **Position the nearest arm:** Place the arm closest to you straight out at a right angle to their body.
2. **Position the other arm:** Bring their other arm across their chest, placing the back of their hand against their opposite cheek.
3. **Bend the far leg:** Bend their leg furthest from you at the knee, keeping their foot flat on the ground.
4. **Roll them onto their side:** Pull gently on the bent knee to roll them toward you onto their side, supporting their head and neck.
5. **Stabilize and tilt:** Adjust the bent knee so both the hip and knee are bent at roughly right angles to stop them from rolling onto their stomach or back. Tilt their head slightly back/downward so the airway stays open and fluids can drain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXUkU6h-9k20zpIZaD6OR5xgOX3qfLjDEGxNFQ7cCw6fYKiSgZdURCGppQEUJq0A2wQko2fBuBPr-rbVsEk3yAdu_nfSlUEgR6B0xJiKb1ngpESTBvK-Zcru1AIXUvORLWkVWLYKyTSTWFPVIyB-xGpiO5L99L)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17xYQlYYQaH8Au0qQRBtFYQwvfw4p4DYvzftit0Ub_XYcw7A2vd7ejQMVydIcRFyacp9_PLWtMBsGjs875uD8VInLKL__aIbPtbH787_wOD0KoUwr49_fxW8wqZvDMRqmVfj6YN3i_ea2CCwa1WdV4-raX3jIVJzZVsS8oyVD2uA56v9Bv_0KFQg2DU)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/mPcOV1_5oQQ)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DAZCnU9J3b7/?hl=en)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXqNJwj3me6Ddv16in7g-u-ynI9RNXy_9Xb5gR28OYusWcbfX_DemiAh2F0SSl4f2wabylbtCN39tnTcZAGwgcA8cfkV0rxTppRT1KeJoPjl-BaFHbNmtXEhZY6CBawZjX8F8zPA)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5DAvv9OsabQ)

### Key Safety Rules

- **Never leave them alone:** Stay with them and check their breathing continuously.
- **Start CPR if not breathing:** If they stop breathing normally, roll them onto their back and begin chest compressions immediately.
- **Do not "sleep it off" or give food/drinks:** Never leave someone passed out on their back, and do not give them coffee, food, or a cold shower.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXfuCmhsfD0k-Tircc6Ipi7Ke6zaLMt1n28L3JyeYne4J0iKOulKsPuHhxiM9AYwMSTcDipUQuIk4T1_dhGC6Sm7wIfhj8Nfm1h0VsiyBVOKMux22IWONreZr-dSgQafDFYhUKngxnbL54Dq7lU6oP518)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1-Vey8GX2Lm3b8Ts6193oTrlrDsEvhRvebwrpu5qOIXQf-rnbl1QsJP6l01MD4-pZRHKHQYW4r_V8_XwKT-WfKvt_sk_CIEsBQWQ9aEX-cOWtJROZeXd8Mx2ht1Z9XjJXOfaLZp4sAYxB9t1RxMpzEOqJv7kXTgW5_UYT_uJYY6y01sc1Ue6VzAzIVC1Q2dz_T0zOb-o2DI3sun0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXqNJwj3me6Ddv16in7g-u-ynI9RNXy_9Xb5gR28OYusWcbfX_DemiAh2F0SSl4f2wabylbtCN39tnTcZAGwgcA8cfkV0rxTppRT1KeJoPjl-BaFHbNmtXEhZY6CBawZjX8F8zPA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF18QJeAr9TpacDy7tVwlgPTk76q6t5yFCa_JSojUGotL6EG-45zSxyJXuByxnPFx6L_GbgBV0jv8PlYyGdxYJ0jubDPoUr1PB38iyEgccJms1KwakhL6F-tL9NcER0z1ACAA06KwDMHIr7D27rq6_1O-Xcy9tHLQ9qMfwwR_7w14bfT9KqEhLOzvTGL43QEF0ASrc0s2JwOEVjzj_S_S8FsTmpf0p7R5KKpc)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXwQ1RkXSxfZqwofuoBq4zUia4nxAD9iDgSscEMtR3ILjCxPscP77iNQsgYUXE0NDH6a3skL6NqV2TinPj6xAMeB1eQhutKcwrf4cdnIOr8kj0Rq3QWwyniA_fJjcDfBFXPAEMCG3HUks)
